verdict.rationale: HumanLayer has no documented region or data-residency selection, but it does let users decide where agent work runs and where code lives. You can bring your own compute or run the HumanLayer stack on a workstation or remote workers. Remote daemons can sit on a cloud VM, workstation, or private-network machine of your choosing, and Claude can be routed through Amazon Bedrock instead of the Anthropic API. Session data still appears on app.humanlayer.com, and no storage region is documented for it. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection for HumanLayer-stored data, documentation of where Cloud session data is stored, independent corroboration.
